LOCAL COMERCIAL DE 50 m² EN CALLE JAPÓN – SEVILLA ESTE

Se alquila local comercial de 50 m² construidos, situado en la calle Japón, en Sevilla Este.

inv.desc_en:
50 m² COMMERCIAL PREMISES ON CALLE JAPÓN – SEVILLA ESTE

Commercial premises of 50 m² built area for rent, located on Calle Japón, in Sevilla Este.

The premises are in raw condition, ideal for fitting out and adapting to the needs of your business, designing the space to your liking from the start.

Due to its characteristics, it offers possibilities for entrepreneurs, freelancers, and professionals looking for a space to develop their commercial or professional activity.

An opportunity to create a custom business in an established area of Sevilla Este.

If you are looking for a space to develop your project, do not hesitate to contact us for more information or to arrange a visit.
